description: This file defines the 'Days' class which provides a method to calculate the number of days between two dates, supporting various date input formats. It is part of the PhpOffice PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically within the Calculation component for DateTimeExcel functions.

classes.name: Days
classes.description: Provides a function to compute the number of days between two dates, supporting multiple input formats and array inputs.

methods.name: between
methods.description: Calculates the number of days between two specified dates, handling array inputs and various date formats.
